items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did a little tenor and guitar thing with Jim Hall that was kind of nice.

ctx.x: Yes. Eight twenty-one, Sixth Avenue at twenty-eighth street. There were a lot of players who were in and out of there in those years. Were you there on occasion?
On occasion. Not that frequently I think. I think Zoot was kind of a standard player there. Jim Hall, Jim Rainey, and those kind of guys.

Bill Crow, Brookmeyer, and Warne I guess on occasion. There was also a radio series a year or so ago on WNYC, a friend of mine, Sara Fishko produced, and they did a ten show series on the jazz loft and they did a whole episode on Ronnie Free.
